designSketchCases: a5s remote silence window can impose4999ms on newly started writing without a hint
a deadline refreshed by unrelated hot work can postpone a quiet publisher indefinitely
clear-only invalidation allows a pre-hint result to recreate quiet state; a captured generation refuses it
notification-only suppression has no finite discovery bound when an advisory hint is lost
first and newly eligible publishers remain due
a fixed1s deadline expires exactly, and unrelated completions cannot extend it
clock rollback and changed cursor/authority basis do not defer
all-idle, own and conflicted paths remain outside remote quiet deferral
hint, reconnect and authority reset invalidate already recorded hints and every old in-flight token
productive, unknown and refused outcomes cannot create or keep an empty hint
memory eviction makes an old publisher due instead of deferring an unrelated stream
limitations: The sketch is a proposed scheduling boundary only, not production code or evidence about native verification, end-to-end clocks or security qualification.
A1s expiry bounds intentional deferral in the sketch, not actual network-to-DOM time. The2.5s gate still needs a real candidate comparison.
